layout_doc.magic: u32 0x5846504F ('OFPX' little endian) set by the first hook that runs; 0 means no hook has run yet
layout_doc.disable: u32 bit mask, a SET bit switches a feature off at run time; bit 0 = one-owner enemy rule, bit 1 = command mailbox, bit 2 = shared checkpoint loads, bit 3 = enemy animations, bit 4 = handing the animation sets of a dropped copy to the puppet (value 16), bit 5 = trigger distance gate (value 32)
layout_doc.cnt_apply_calls: u32 calls of the ApplySpawn hook
layout_doc.cnt_send_calls: u32 calls of the SendSpawn hook
layout_doc.cnt_own_destroyed: u32 times our own enemy was destroyed as a duplicate
layout_doc.cnt_puppet_destroyed: u32 times a puppet was destroyed as a duplicate
layout_doc.cmd_seq: u32 command mailbox, test -> game: the test writes cmd, cmd_arg_len and cmd_arg first and cmd_seq LAST (res_seq + 1); the per-frame hook runs the command when cmd_seq != res_seq
layout_doc.cmd: u32 1 = LOAD_CHECKPOINT (cmd_arg = name NUL persistent-level-name NUL, ASCII, each at most 127 bytes; the persistent name may be empty)
layout_doc.cmd_arg_len: u32 bytes of cmd_arg in use
layout_doc.res_seq: u32 game -> test: set to cmd_seq when the command has been handled
layout_doc.res_code: i32 0 = started, 2 = unknown command, 3 = bad argument
layout_doc.follow_pending: u32 set by the receive hook when a partner's WORLD_CHECKPOINT_LOAD (0x11) arrived; the per-frame hook loads follow_name and clears it
layout_doc.cnt_follow_sent: u32 checkpoint loads told to the partners
layout_doc.cnt_echo_suppressed: u32 loads not re-sent because they were a partner's load
layout_doc.cnt_rebroadcast: u32 times our enemies were announced again because a partner had a copy of one of them (the partner may have loaded after our first announcement)
layout_doc.spawn_table: 64 entries of 24 bytes {u64 actor, f32 x, y, z, u32 class low bits}: where each own enemy and each puppet was first seen; the one-owner rule compares these places, so a copy that walked away after it appeared is still recognised. Cleared on every checkpoint load
layout_doc.rebroadcast_ctrl: u64 the multiplayer controller whose 'already announced' list the per-frame hook clears (0 = nothing to do)
layout_doc.cnt_anim_sent: u32 enemy animations announced to the partners (bit 3 of disable switches the feature off)
layout_doc.cnt_anim_played: u32 animations started on a puppet through the script function PlayFullBodyAnim
layout_doc.cnt_anim_dropped: u32 received animations not played (no such puppet, dead, no animation slot, function not found)
layout_doc.cnt_trig_seen: u32 world trigger packets (WORLD_TRIGGER_ACT) seen by the distance gate (bit 5 of disable switches it off)
layout_doc.cnt_trig_dropped: u32 trigger packets dropped because the sender stood farther from the local hero than the radius
layout_doc.trigger_r2: u32 the squared radius of the trigger gate as float bits; 0 = the default, 3000 units (9000000.0)
layout_doc.cnt_anim_resolved: u32 times a puppet without animation sets found them by the owner's paths (the lookup, not the handover from a twin)
layout_doc.anim_wr: u32 write index of anim_ring (taken modulo 4)
layout_doc.last_ctrl: u64 the multiplayer controller seen by the enemy hooks; the per-frame hook plays queued animations only when it runs for this controller
layout_doc.anim_ring: 4 entries of 0x200 bytes: u32 valid (written last), i32 sender, u32 flags (bit 0 = loop, bit 1 = refresh), u32 rate, blendIn, blendOut, start, end (raw float bits), char enemy[64] at +0x30, char anim[64] at +0x70, u32 number of anim set paths at +0xB0, char sets[4][80] at +0xC0
layout_doc.anim_state: 32 entries of 16 bytes {u64 enemy actor, u32 FName index, u32 FName number, u32 calls since the last announcement}: the animation already announced for an own enemy; cleared when its animation ends
layout_doc.expect_name: char[128] the partner's load being executed here (echo guard)
layout_doc.persist_table: pairs 'checkpoint-name prefix NUL persistent level NUL', ends with an empty prefix; written into the file by the applier (data_init)
